sessions.work: Compute integer parity by alternating countdown branches. Each repetition uses n or n+1; the checksum must be repeats/2.
sessions.comparison: Three current-fwp implementations; no C/Rust peer or language-wide overhead claim. Ordinary and grouped variants start from identical typed IR. Explicit uses the public loop combinator.
sessions.timing: Fresh-process wall time, including runtime startup, repetitions, checksum output and cleanup. No instrumentation in timed executables. A volatile C entry pointer prevents hoisting repeated calls; this common boundary cost is included.
sessions.storage: Separate instrumented binaries count managed requests during entry calls and sample C stack addresses with GCC function hooks. Per-function compiler stack estimates and actual binaries are retained separately.

sessions.work: Compute integer parity by alternating countdown branches. Each repetition uses n or n+1; the checksum must be repeats/2.
sessions.comparison: Three current-fwp implementations; no C/Rust peer or language-wide overhead claim. Ordinary and grouped variants start from identical typed IR. Explicit uses the public loop combinator.
sessions.timing: Fresh-process wall time, including runtime startup, repetitions, checksum output and cleanup. No instrumentation in timed executables. A volatile C entry pointer prevents hoisting repeated calls; this common boundary cost is included.
sessions.storage: Separate instrumented binaries count managed requests during entry calls and sample C stack addresses with GCC function hooks. Per-function compiler stack estimates and actual binaries are retained separately.
